dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region contains 4-5 irregular 'C' and 'O' shaped structures characterized by jagged, non-linear outer perimeters. These structures exhibit a sharp pixel-intensity gradient transitioning from the dark-grey exterior skin to high-intensity white interior boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the anterior neck region and scattered along the ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the central high-contrast region form an obtuse triangle, while a secondary geometric relationship is formed by a linear alignment of high-intensity blobs along the lower neck.
